text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's a new recipe, but it actually turned 
out pretty—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It seems I made a mistake with the 
seasoning. How careless of me..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I thought it turned out well, but... 
*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's an uncharacteristic mistake for 
Cesario, who's great at cooking. Could 
race fatigue be piling up? Maybe I should 
review her schedule and commitments.
